description: Nhóm vốn hóa (Small-cap/Mid-cap/Large-cap) — grain key, phân loại theo MarketCap quy đổi USD
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN listed_share_info ON listed_share_info.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol AND listed_share_info.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND listed_share_info.ds_snpst_dt = (SELECT MAX(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) FROM listed_share_info sc2 WHERE sc2.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol AND sc2.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND sc2.ds_snpst_dt <= security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt) LEFT JOIN cl_risk_indicator_value ON cl_risk_indicator_value.cl_risk_ind_code = 'EX_RATE_VND_USD' AND cl_risk_indicator_value.period_dt = security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt LOOKUP status_threshold_config ON status_threshold_config.index_code = 'CAP_GROUP' AND (security_trading_snapshot.close_price * listed_share_info.outstanding_share_quantity / NULLIF(cl_risk_indicator_value.val, 0)) BETWEEN status_threshold_config.from_value AND status_threshold_config.to_value -> status_threshold_config.status WHERE security_trading_snapshot.floor_code IN ('02','04','10') GROUP BY status_threshold_config.status, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt
source_entity: Security Trading Snapshot / Listed Share Info / Classification Risk Indicator Value / Status Threshold Configuration

description: GTGD khớp lệnh toàn nhóm vốn hóa tại ngày t
etl_logic: SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) JOIN security_trading_snapshot.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code AND security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt LEFT JOIN listed_share_info ON listed_share_info.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol AND listed_share_info.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND listed_share_info.ds_snpst_dt = (SELECT MAX(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) FROM listed_share_info sc2 WHERE sc2.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol AND sc2.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND sc2.ds_snpst_dt <= security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt) LEFT JOIN cl_risk_indicator_value ON cl_risk_indicator_value.cl_risk_ind_code = 'EX_RATE_VND_USD' AND cl_risk_indicator_value.period_dt = security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt WHERE security_trading_snapshot.floor_code IN ('02','04','10') AND securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX') GROUP BY (cap_group_classification per mã CK — xem etl_logic cột Cap Group Code), security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, trong do cap_group_classification = LOOKUP status_threshold_config ON status_threshold_config.index_code = 'CAP_GROUP' AND (security_trading_snapshot.close_price * listed_share_info.outstanding_share_quantity / NULLIF(cl_risk_indicator_value.val, 0)) BETWEEN status_threshold_config.from_value AND status_threshold_config.to_value -> status_threshold_config.status
source_entity: Securities Trade / Security Trading Snapshot / Listed Share Info

description: Tỷ trọng thanh khoản nhóm = GTGD nhóm / GTGD toàn thị trường x 100
etl_logic: SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) JOIN security_trading_snapshot.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code AND security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt LEFT JOIN listed_share_info ON listed_share_info.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol AND listed_share_info.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND listed_share_info.ds_snpst_dt = (SELECT MAX(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) FROM listed_share_info sc2 WHERE sc2.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol AND sc2.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND sc2.ds_snpst_dt <= security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt) LEFT JOIN cl_risk_indicator_value ON cl_risk_indicator_value.cl_risk_ind_code = 'EX_RATE_VND_USD' AND cl_risk_indicator_value.period_dt = security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt WHERE security_trading_snapshot.floor_code IN ('02','04','10') AND securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX') GROUP BY (cap_group_classification per mã CK), security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt / NULLIF(SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) JOIN security_trading_snapshot.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code AND security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt WHERE security_trading_snapshot.floor_code IN ('02','04','10') AND securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX') GROUP BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, 0) * 100, trong do cap_group_classification = LOOKUP status_threshold_config ON status_threshold_config.index_code = 'CAP_GROUP' AND (security_trading_snapshot.close_price * listed_share_info.outstanding_share_quantity / NULLIF(cl_risk_indicator_value.val, 0)) BETWEEN status_threshold_config.from_value AND status_threshold_config.to_value -> status_threshold_config.status
